files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An inline month calendar, styled after shadcn's Calendar (Base UI + vega).
  # The days are rendered by the ruby-ui--calendar Stimulus controller from the
  # templates in CalendarWeekdays and CalendarDays.
  #
  # week_starts_on: :sunday (default, as in shadcn) through :saturday, or 0-6.
  class Calendar < Base
    WEEKDAYS = %i[sunday monday tuesday wednesday thursday friday saturday].freeze

    def initialize(selected_date: nil, min_date: nil, input_id: nil, date_format: "yyyy-MM-dd", week_starts_on: :sunday, **attrs)
      @selected_date = selected_date
      @min_date = min_date
      @input_id = input_id
      @date_format = date_format
      @week_starts_on = self.class.week_start_index(week_starts_on)
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def self.week_start_index(value)
      index = value.is_a?(Integer) ? value : WEEKDAYS.index(value.to_s.to_sym)
      raise ArgumentError, "week_starts_on must be one of #{WEEKDAYS.join(", ")} or 0-6, got #{value.inspect}" unless index&.between?(0, 6)

      index
    end

    def view_template
      div(**attrs) do
        RubyUI.CalendarHeader do
          nav(aria_label: "Navigation bar", class: "absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-1") do
            RubyUI.CalendarPrev
            RubyUI.CalendarNext
          end
          RubyUI.CalendarTitle
        end
        RubyUI.CalendarBody # Where the calendar is rendered (Weekdays and Days)
        RubyUI.CalendarWeekdays(week_starts_on: @week_starts_on) # Template for the weekdays
        RubyUI.CalendarDays # Template for the days
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "w-fit bg-background p-3 in-data-[slot=card-content]:bg-transparent in-data-[slot=popover-content]:bg-transparent",
        data: {
          controller: "ruby-ui--calendar",
          ruby_ui__calendar_selected_date_value: @selected_date&.to_s,
          ruby_ui__calendar_min_date_value: @min_date&.to_s,
          ruby_ui__calendar_format_value: @date_format,
          ruby_ui__calendar_week_starts_on_value: @week_starts_on,
          ruby_ui__calendar_ruby_ui__calendar_input_outlet: @input_id
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CalendarBody < Base
    def view_template
      table(**attrs)
    end

    private

    # The controller fills the grid and sets aria-label to the month and year.
    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "grid",
        class: "w-full border-collapse",
        data: {
          ruby_ui__calendar_target: "calendar",
          action: "keydown->ruby-ui--calendar#navigate"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Mustache templates the ruby-ui--calendar controller renders each day with.
  # Placeholders: {{date}} (yyyy-mm-dd), {{dayDate}} (day of month),
  # {{label}} (full date, e.g. "Monday, March 16th, 2026") and {{tabindex}}
  # (0 on the one day in the Tab sequence, -1 elsewhere).
  class CalendarDays < Base
    BASE_CLASS = "inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border-0 border-transparent p-0 text-sm leading-none font-normal whitespace-nowrap " \
      "transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:relative focus-visible:z-10 " \
      "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"
    HOVER_CLASS = "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50"
    CELL_CLASS = "relative rounded-md p-0 text-center select-none"

    def view_template
      render_disabled_date_template
      render_selected_date_template
      render_today_date_template
      render_current_month_date_template
      render_other_month_date_template
    end

    private

    def render_disabled_date_template
      date_template("disabledDateTemplate") do
        day_button([BASE_CLASS, "text-muted-foreground"], disabled: true, tabindex: "-1", data: {action: nil})
      end
    end

    def render_selected_date_template
      date_template("selectedDateTemplate", aria_selected: "true") do
        day_button([BASE_CLASS, "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"])
      end
    end

    def render_today_date_template
      date_template("todayDateTemplate", cell_class: [CELL_CLASS, "rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground"]) do
        day_button([BASE_CLASS, "text-foreground", HOVER_CLASS])
      end
    end

    def render_current_month_date_template
      date_template("currentMonthDateTemplate") do
        day_button([BASE_CLASS, "text-foreground", HOVER_CLASS])
      end
    end

    def render_other_month_date_template
      date_template("otherMonthDateTemplate") do
        day_button([BASE_CLASS, "text-muted-foreground", HOVER_CLASS])
      end
    end

    def day_button(classes, tabindex: "{{tabindex}}", **options)
      data = {day: "{{date}}", action: "click->ruby-ui--calendar#selectDay"}.merge(options.delete(:data) || {}).compact
      button(
        type: "button",
        name: "day",
        class: classes,
        tabindex: tabindex,
        aria_label: "{{label}}",
        data: data,
        **options
      ) { "{{dayDate}}" }
    end

    def date_template(target, cell_class: CELL_CLASS, **cell_attrs, &block)
      template(data: {ruby_ui__calendar_target: target}) do
        td(class: cell_class, role: "gridcell", **cell_attrs, &block)
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CalendarHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "relative mb-4 flex h-8 w-full items-center justify-center px-8"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CalendarNext < Base
    def view_template
      button(**attrs) do
        icon
      end
    end

    private

    # lucide chevron, as in shadcn.
    def icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        class: "size-4",
        aria_hidden: "true"
      ) do |s|
        s.path(d: "m9 18 6-6-6-6")
      end
    end

    # shadcn's ghost Button at the calendar cell size.
    def default_attrs
      {
        name: "next-month",
        aria_label: "Go to the Next Month",
        class: CalendarPrev::NAV_CLASS,
        type: "button",
        data_action: "click->ruby-ui--calendar#nextMonth"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CalendarPrev < Base
    NAV_CLASS = "group/button inline-flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent " \
      "bg-clip-padding p-0 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none " \
      "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px " \
      "disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-disabled:opacity-50 " \
      "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0"

    def view_template
      button(**attrs) do
        icon
      end
    end

    private

    # lucide chevron, as in shadcn.
    def icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        class: "size-4",
        aria_hidden: "true"
      ) do |s|
        s.path(d: "m15 18-6-6 6-6")
      end
    end

    # shadcn's ghost Button at the calendar cell size.
    def default_attrs
      {
        name: "previous-month",
        aria_label: "Go to the Previous Month",
        class: NAV_CLASS,
        type: "button",
        data_action: "click->ruby-ui--calendar#prevMonth"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CalendarWeekdays < Base
    DAYS = %w[Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday].freeze

    def initialize(week_starts_on: 0, **attrs)
      @week_starts_on = RubyUI::Calendar.week_start_index(week_starts_on)
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      template(data: {ruby_ui__calendar_target: "weekdaysTemplate"}) do
        # As in shadcn, the column headers are hidden: each day button carries
        # its full date as its accessible name.
        thead(**attrs) do
          tr(class: "flex") do
            DAYS.rotate(@week_starts_on).each do |day|
              render_day(day)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def render_day(day)
      th(
        scope: "col",
        class: "w-8 rounded-md text-[0.8rem] font-normal text-muted-foreground select-none",
        aria_label: day
      ) { day[0..1] }
    end

    def default_attrs
      {aria_hidden: "true"}
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Calendar

A calendar that lets users pick a date, with keyboard navigation.

## Usage

### Connect to input

```ruby
div(class: 'space-y-4') do
  Input(type: 'string', placeholder: "Select a date", class: 'rounded-md border shadow', id: 'date', data_controller: 'ruby-ui--calendar-input')
  Calendar(input_id: '#date', class: 'rounded-md border shadow')
end
```

### Format date

```ruby
div(class: 'space-y-4') do
  Input(type: 'string', placeholder: "Select a date", class: 'rounded-md border shadow', id: 'formatted-date', data_controller: 'ruby-ui--calendar-input')
  Calendar(input_id: '#formatted-date', date_format: 'PPPP', class: 'rounded-md border shadow')
end
```

### Minimum date

```ruby
div(class: 'space-y-4') do
  Input(type: 'string', placeholder: "Select a date", class: 'rounded-md border shadow', id: 'minimum-date', data_controller: 'ruby-ui--calendar-input')
  Calendar(input_id: '#minimum-date', min_date: Date.current, class: 'rounded-md border shadow')
end
```

### Week start

```ruby
Calendar(week_starts_on: :monday, class: 'rounded-md border shadow')
```
